article.title: Hackers Exploit N-able MailAssure Flaw While AI Agents Exploit MONAI Label Zero-Day
article.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Monday added two flaws impacting N-able MailAssure and MONAI Label to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. article.title: Azure Flaw Exploited to Target Secrets at Norwegian Energy Firms
article.summary: Microsoft closed an Azure API Management flaw exploited to target secrets at Norwegian energy companies, with other sectors also affected. The post Azure Flaw Exploited to Target Secrets at Norwegian Energy Firms appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.relevance_reason: Hacker đã khai thác một lỗ hổng trong Azure API Management nhằm đánh cắp thông tin xác thực tại các công ty năng lượng Na Uy.

article.title: GL.iNet cloud compromise hits routers and KVMs, older backdoors also found
article.summary: Attackers compromised GoodCloud, GL.iNet’s cloud remote management service, and used it to install malware on routers and KVM (keyboard, video and mouse) devices connected to it. The Chinese company, best known for its small travel routers, is still investigating, and it’s not yet known how many devices have been affected. article.title: FBI reportedly facing second data breach involving National Crime Information Center
article.summary: The FBI is reportedly investigating a data breach involving the National Crime Information Center, a database used by U.S. law enforcement agencies that contains information on criminals, fugitives and missing people.
